profile_text.body:
Seesaw Learning operates Seesaw, which its website describes as a Learning Experience Platform with more than 25 million users. The company says the platform is aimed at elementary education, engagement, and school culture, and that it works to improve academic success. The site also states that teacher-led AI is built in, letting teachers create activities faster and adapt them to their students while staying in control of instruction.

The site's description places AI in a supporting role for lesson and activity creation rather than as a standalone product. Seesaw is tracked as an Education and Research AI product, with AI translation features reported. Its stated uses are student portfolios and family communication, for teachers, students, and families. Pricing is reported as a free plan, Seesaw Plus at $120 per teacher per year, and district plans priced per student, though that pricing comes from a secondary source and needs official confirmation. Student age range and privacy practices are not verified.
